CREATE TABLE "investment_assignment_audit" (
	"id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
	"actor_id" text NOT NULL,
	"reviewer_id" text NOT NULL,
	"client_id" text NOT NULL,
	"action" text NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	"grant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
	"occurred_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL,
	"granted_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"revoked_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"credential_reference" text,
	"credential_valid_until" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_assignment_audit_action_check" CHECK (action = ANY (ARRAY['grant'::text, 'revoke'::text])),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_assignment_audit_check" CHECK (reviewer_id <> client_id),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_assignment_audit_reason_check" CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 10)
);

CREATE TABLE "investment_professional_reviews" (
	"id" varchar PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"reviewer_id" text NOT NULL,
	"client_id" text NOT NULL,
	"report_id" varchar NOT NULL,
	"report_version" varchar(64) NOT NULL,
	"profile_version" varchar(64) NOT NULL,
	"decision" varchar(8) NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	"recommendation_text" text,
	"reviewed_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_professional_reviews_check" CHECK (((decision)::text <> 'approved'::text) OR (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM recommendation_text)) >= 10)),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_professional_reviews_decision_check" CHECK ((decision)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['approved'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[])),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_professional_reviews_reason_check" CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 10)
);

CREATE TABLE "investment_assignment_administrators" (
	"user_id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"provisioned_by" text NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	"provisioned_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"revoked_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_assignment_administrators_reason_check" CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 10)
);

CREATE TABLE "investment_simulation_studies" (
	"id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
	"user_id" text NOT NULL,
	"request_key" uuid NOT NULL,
	"ticker" varchar(12) NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_simulation_studies_ticker_check" CHECK ((ticker)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['BBDC3'::character varying, 'BBAS3'::character varying])::text[]))
);

CREATE TABLE "investment_review_professional" (
	"reviewer_id" text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	"singleton" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"credential_reference" text NOT NULL,
	"verified_by" text NOT NULL,
	"verified_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"valid_until" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"revoked_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_review_professional_singleton_key" UNIQUE("singleton"),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_review_professional_check" CHECK (valid_until > verified_at),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_review_professional_credential_reference_check" CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM credential_reference)) >= 10),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_review_professional_singleton_check" CHECK (singleton = true)
);

CREATE TABLE "investment_consultant_authorizations" (
	"grant_id" uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
	"reviewer_id" text NOT NULL,
	"client_id" text NOT NULL,
	"granted_by" text NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	"granted_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
	"revoked_at" timestamp with time zone,
	CONSTRAINT "investment_consultant_authorizations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("reviewer_id","client_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_consultant_authorizations_check" CHECK (reviewer_id <> client_id),
	CONSTRAINT "investment_consultant_authorizations_reason_check" CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 10)
);

ALTER TABLE "investment_assignment_audit" ADD CONSTRAINT "investment_assignment_audit_reviewer_id_client_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("reviewer_id","client_id") REFERENCES "public"."investment_consultant_authorizations"("reviewer_id","client_id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;

ALTER TABLE "investment_professional_reviews" ADD CONSTRAINT "investment_professional_reviews_report_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("report_id") REFERENCES "public"."investment_reports"("id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;

ALTER TABLE "investment_professional_reviews" ADD CONSTRAINT "investment_professional_reviews_reviewer_id_client_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("reviewer_id","client_id") REFERENCES "public"."investment_consultant_authorizations"("reviewer_id","client_id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
CREATE INDEX "investment_assignment_audit_client_idx" ON "investment_assignment_audit" USING btree ("client_id","occurred_at" DESC NULLS FIRST,"id");
CREATE INDEX "investment_professional_reviews_context_idx" ON "investment_professional_reviews" USING btree ("client_id","report_id","reviewed_at" DESC NULLS FIRST);
CREATE INDEX "investment_simulation_history_idx" ON "investment_simulation_studies" USING btree ("user_id","created_at" DESC NULLS FIRST,"id");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "investment_simulation_request_idx" ON "investment_simulation_studies" USING btree ("user_id","request_key");

ALTER TABLE "report_delivery_requests" ADD CONSTRAINT "report_delivery_requests_professional_review_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("professional_review_id") REFERENCES "public"."investment_professional_reviews"("id") ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
